name: PrivilegeLogBuilder
tagline: Build, QC and serve a defensible privilege log on the Power Platform.
description: eDiscovery privilege log app in one PCF control: privilege coding, FRCP 26(b)(5)-ready descriptions, attorney and third-party (waiver) checks, document families, redactions, four-eyes second-level QC, challenges, release and clawback, and a served-log CSV export. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages; demo data included.
features: 11 automatic QC checks (description length and boilerplate, reused descriptions, attorney present, third-party waiver risk, missing log fields, work product before anticipation, redaction count, not privileged but withheld, family consistency, missing basis)
Status workflow Flagged → Coded → QC review → QC approved → Logged → Challenged → Released with validation
Four-eyes QC with keyboard shortcuts and waiver override with reason
Serve approved entries on a log version and export the served log (attorneys marked *)
Bulk basis, treatment, reviewer, move and export with undo
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
